_comment: Trust policy for the portal's read-only discovery role (paired with
iam-policy-portal-discovery.json). Bound to the BACKEND's service
account, not the executor's — that separation is the whole point: the
executor role is the only identity permitted to mutate EC2, and the gate
process must never be able to assume it. Two roles, two service accounts,
Replace ACCOUNT_ID and OIDC_PROVIDER, and confirm the service account name
matches the backend Deployment's in the manifest repo (liam-ng/
liam-dev-k8s-argoCD, apps/mcp-approval-gate/base) — the sub is exact-match,
so a rename there silently breaks credential resolution here.
IRSA only works where an EKS OIDC provider exists. On the liam-dev WSL
cluster there is none (docs/plan.md, 2026-08-07), so the backend takes
mounted credentials from ESO instead and AWS_DISCOVERY_ROLE_ARN names the
role to assume; that path needs an additional statement here trusting the
source principal, exactly as the executor role already does.
